sourceText: User said: "那就开始做第一组吧" after approving the 10x15 UDM no-false-DONE baseline design. In this story, "first group" means G01 only.
normalizedOutcome: Implement the first baseline group G01 as a deterministic positive-control smoke for one 15-row parent-roadmap ledger, with documentation and validation boundaries that do not claim the full 10x15 baseline is complete.
acceptanceClaim: G01 has a runnable deterministic smoke proving exactly 15 closed rows and full_roadmap_complete locally, while docs and validation state that only G01 is implemented and no Authority, production, fullAuthority, or two-host completion claim is made.
